full_judgment: 2. The application for amendment arose out of the following situation. The opposite party instituted the suit for permanent injunction on various allegations against the petitioner. His case was that the suit property along with other property belonged to Nowab Estate, Dhaka and subsequently was managed by Court of Wards. The opposite party after taking settlement of the suit land from the Chief Manager of Nowab Court of Wards was in possession on payment of Salami and rent. During his peaceful possession as owner, some of the employees of the petitioner tried to encroach upon the land on November 20, 1986.
